services.not_separable: Plain DNS on UDP/TCP 53 to 1.1.1.1, 1.0.0.1 (and 1.1.1.2/1.0.0.2, 1.1.1.3/1.0.0.3 for Families) has no SNI and is addressed by IP only. DoH JSON and DoH wireformat share the host and the path /dns-query and differ only by the Accept or Content-Type media type, so a rule that sees only SNI cannot split them; DoT and DoH to the same resolver differ only by port. The query name inside a DoH or DoT request is the user's lookup, not an application identity. ODoH queries reach odoh.cloudflare-dns.com through a third-party proxy, so the on-path host is usually the proxy, not Cloudflare. The DNS over Tor hidden service (tor.cloudflare-dns.com) is not visible as a normal host.
